notes.title: Update Planetaries v1.75
notes.content:
[b]Thank you all for the support, feedback, and suggestions. Again! I can't express how much I appreciate the kind-hearted people in this community! This update focus is bug fixing, system improvements, and overall performance enhancements:[/b]


[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that was limiting tech tree options

[*] Fixed a UI bug related to the scroll function

[*] Fixed a minor bug related to crafting

[*] Fixed a bug related to AI movement

[*] Fixed a minor server networking bug that impacted performance for some players

[*] Fixed an async-related bug

[*] Fixed a minor buildable positioning bug

notes.title: Update Planetaries v1.71 - More Optimization
notes.content:
[b]Thank you all for the support, feedback, and suggestions. Again! I can't express how much I appreciate the kind-hearted people in this community! This update focuses on optimization and game stability. As we move forward, I continually seek out areas to optimize and improve, recognizing that many features are still experimental within the engine. Addressing certain optimization challenges requires unique solutions, especially for issues not yet resolved by the engine developers.[/b]

[h3]Here’s what’s new in this update:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Mesh Streaming Performance increase.

[*] Major Rendering Performance increase.

[*] Improved Game Runtime Stability.

[*] Fixed game stability issues.

[*] Fixed engine-related stability issues.

[*] Fixed minor UI bugs.

[*] Fixed background tasks cleaning issues.

[*] Improved Random Events system.

[*] Increased Nucleium stack size to 5000.

[*] Added new boss type "Antkore".

[*] Added a new random event encounter.

[*] Added Buildable Proximity Missile Trap.

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/HxDGLYJ/1.gif[/img][/url]

[b]Thank you for your continued support and feedback![/b]

notes.title: Update Planetaries v1.70 - First Person
notes.content:
[b]Thank you all for the support, feedback, and suggestions. Again! I can't express how much I appreciate the kind-hearted people in this community! After a lot of intense work, I've successfully added an experimental First-Person view! This update brings not only this exciting new mode but also a lot of great tweaks and additions to enhance gameplay.[/b]

[h3]What's New:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Experimental First Person View:
You can switch to first person by holding the camera key (default: "C").
Note: This is an experimental mode. It may have bugs, visual artifacts, and some animations may appear off since they weren't originally designed for first person. I hope to refine this over time as development progresses.

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/TkcfM2C/1.gif[/img][/url]
[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/QdVkh6P/3.gif[/img][/url]

[*] Added Buildable Structure Repair Station:
This structure will repair nearby damaged structures within a radius and consume Nucleium as a resource.

[*]Added New Item "Energized Battery"

[*]Added New Buildable Machine "Nucleium Harvester" this machine can harvest Nucleium resources.

[*]Added New Buildable Machine "Synthesizer" this machine can synthesize crystals.

[*]Minor UI Improvements

[*]Minor Performance Tweaks

[*]Boss hatched creatures now have improved behavior and intelligence

[*]Improved AI Movement System

[*]NPCs will no longer target player vehicles if the player is not inside

[*]Removed Halloween Holiday Music
[/list]

[b]Thank you for all the feedback and support that helps shape these updates! Your input is invaluable as I continue to improve the game. Enjoy![/b]

notes.title: Update Planetaries v1.68 - DLSS / FSR
notes.content:
[b]Thank you all for the support, feedback, and suggestions. Again! I can't express how much I appreciate the kind-hearted people in this community! This update is technical, focusing on adding Nvidia's and AMD's latest DLSS and FSR technology to Planetaries as well as Frame Generation. I've noticed some of you really want a First Person view. It could be possible, but I can't promise much right now. Adding First Person support would take a lot of development time, which means no new content, features, or updates for a while. It will be considered.[/b]

[h3]Update Content:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added Nvidia DLSS Support and included the setting in the Graphic Settings.

[*] Added AMD FSR Support and included the setting in the Graphic Settings.

[*] Added DLSS Quality option to the Graphic Settings.

[*] Added Frame Generation support and included the setting in the Graphic Settings.

[*] Fixed minor server issues to improve stability.

[*] Improved overall performance.

[*] Increased despawn timer for all elite aliens.

[*] Increased despawn timer for all elite pirates and droids.

[*] Increased despawn timer for wandering traders.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Planetaries v1.66 - New Features
notes.content:
[b]Thank you all for the support, feedback, and suggestions. Again! I can't express how much I appreciate the kind-hearted people in this community! In this update, we say goodbye to the old tech tree and introduce a new one that contains more items overall and makes it easier to add content in the future. It’s more straightforward and user-friendly, especially for new players. Alongside this major change, I've also included a lot of improvements, fixes, and new features. [/b]

[h3]Here’s a list of all the new stuff in this update:[/h3]

[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused TD waves to despawn if a bed was built close to their spawn points.

[*]Fixed an issue causing some performance decreases.

[*]Fixed a bug where the launch pad would work even if not placed.

[*]Fixed the main menu Discord link.

[*]Improved sitting for all chairs.

[*]Improved and updated the loot system.

[*]General AI improvements.

[*]UI improvements and changes.

[*]Changes and balancing to all ranged weapons.

[*]Updated all vendors' trade lists.

[*]Increased decay timer for corpses.

[*]Added a new vehicle: HoverBike.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002464/4391a18ddc3cdd8aebc6350893a99f0370486d40.gif[/img]

[*]Added a buildable Teleporter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002464/7fa15112f197d413d40debd178d155ad7a68d44b.gif[/img]

[*]Added new consumables rarity.

[*]Added new rarities to all ranged weapons.

[*]Added energy maces, blades, and heavy swords to the crafting list.

[*]Added new crafting recipes.

[*]Added tooltips to some UI elements.

[*]Added the first implementation of the new tech tree [Tech Data].

[*]Player perk points have been separated into two types: Tech Data and Player Perks.

[*]Added a multiplier setting for TD waves to make it harder and earn higher rewards.
[/list]
[b]Thank you all again for supporting the game and for being kind-hearted. I'm listening closely to your feedback, so please let me know if you like the new changes and the new "Tech Tree."[/b]

notes.title: Update Planetaries v1.63
notes.content:
[b]Thank you all for the support, feedback, and suggestions. Again! I can't express how much I appreciate the kind-hearted people in this community! This update focuses on fixing issues and adding some quality of life features, including the first addition of controller support.[/b]

[h3]What's New:[/h3]

[list]
[b]Added Partial Controller Support:[/b]
[*] All keybinds should now work properly, allowing you to use all in-game actions without issues.
Note: Controller support for menus (e.g., inventory) is not available yet, as it requires more time to implement.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002464/5212e893262d0edd2ba9afe2cd27b08e59089080.png[/img]
[b]Fixes and Improvements:[/b]
[*] Fixed mouse sensitivity settings and added support for controller sensitivity.

[*] Fixed invert mouse setting.

[*] Fixed player ship taking damage when the player has no food.

[*] Improved the "Take All" button, it now closes the window if all items are taken and is bound to the Target Lock keybind.

[*] Improved Performance and Replication Performance.

[*] Improved contracts, all players with the same contract will gain progress.

[*] Balanced alien regrouping distance.

[*] Added the ability to snap ceilings and triangle ceilings to foundations.

[*] Added the ability to sit on decorative sofas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002464/54559631ab20e4f9e2ea792efd014f4542596170.png[/img]

notes.title: Day 1 Hotfix! Server Browser / Steam Invites
notes.content:
[h3]Thank you to all the players supporting Planetaries! [/h3]

[b]I'm dedicated to making this game the greatest.[/b]
[b]In this hotfix:[/b]
[list]
[*]I've added a way to see your Steam friends' servers and an option in the player list tab to invite them to your server. 

[*] I've also fixed a bug where you couldn't rebind the Interaction Key and addressed minor performance issues. 
[/list]

If you're an AMD user experiencing lag spikes or low FPS, consider reverting to an earlier driver version—this is related to Unreal Engine 5 and AMD drivers. 

Thanks again!

notes.title: Game Is Available Right Now!
notes.content:
[h3]Thank you to all the players who have wishlisted and patiently waited for the release of the game, and a warm welcome to all the new players joining us! [/h3]

[b]Your feedback and suggestions are invaluable, and I'm listening closely. [/b]

I'm excited to announce that Controller Support is already on its way! The future of the game is being actively worked on, with a ROAD MAP to be announced by the end of the month.

[b]Thank you again for your incredible support![/b]
